close_reason: stoa-5yi4k.8: Removed dead !peer.tls check from run_smtp_session (do_deliver pre-connect guard already handles it); EHLO REQUIRETLS advertisement check retained. stoa-5yi4k.9: Added SAFETY comments at both std::sync::Mutex lock sites explaining guard is not held across await points. All 291 tests pass.
description: relay_client.rs MtaStsEnforcer uses std::sync::Mutex. It's safe here because the lock is released before every .await (lines 72-77 use a block to drop the guard). But this pattern is subtle: if someone adds code between the block and the first await, or wraps the lock acquisition in an async combinator, they'll create a potential deadlock. Add a // SAFETY: comment at each lock site explaining that the guard is not held across any await point.
title: std::sync::Mutex in MtaStsEnforcer held across async boundary without SAFETY comment
